english: Let $S$ be the set of all $x\in[0,2\pi]$, $x\ne\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$, such that $\tan x>2\sin x$. Then $S$ is a union of intervals whose total length is
hindi: माना कि $S$ उन सभी $x\in[0,2\pi]$, $x\ne\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$, का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए $\tan x>2\sin x$ है। तब $S$ अन्तरालों का एक सम्मिलन है जिनकी कुल लम्बाई है
solution_full: For $\cos x\ne0$: $\tan x-2\sin x=\dfrac{\sin x-2\sin x\cos x}{\cos x}=\dfrac{\sin x\,(1-2\cos x)}{\cos x}$.

The factors vanish or change sign at: $\sin x=0$ ($x=0,\pi,2\pi$), $\cos x=\frac12$ ($x=\frac{\pi}{3},\frac{5\pi}{3}$), $\cos x=0$ ($x=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}$). At $x=0,\pi,2\pi$ the difference is $0$, so these points are not in $S$.
$(0,\frac{\pi}{3})$: $\sin x>0$, $1-2\cos x<0$, $\cos x>0$, so the expression is negative.
Multiplying both sides by $\cos x$ without regard to its sign would lose the interval $(\pi,\frac{3\pi}{2})$ and give $\frac{\pi}{2}$, option (A).
originality_note: New: a three-factor sign chart for tan x - 2 sin x on a full period, asked as the total length of the solution set (way 5: the quotient form plus measure). Closest known: Symbolab-type exercise tan x >= sin x. Different because: the factor 1 - 2 cos x adds the critical points pi/3, 5pi/3 and the answer is a length, not an interval list.

concept_use.Trigonometric inequalities: The inequality tan x > 2 sin x is solved by a sign chart of sin x (1 - 2 cos x)/cos x over [0, 2pi].

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, function and interval is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical scan), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Excluded pi/2 and 3pi/2 explicitly in the stem so tan x is defined on the whole set; the answer is a length so endpoints do not matter. Changed: No change.
key_step: Writing tan x - 2 sin x as a quotient of three factors and running the sign chart without multiplying by cos x.
justification: A standard wavy-curve sign analysis on one period with a trap (multiplying by cos x); routine but multi-step. Similar in demand to the case-split counting of 2021-P1-Q17 (L1) with more stages, so 2.
